regime_context: The TSX thematic rotation is led by Big Banks with a wide margin; the absolute-trend gate is active for most themes. Momentum ranks serve as a focus lens, not alpha, and no single narrative dominates. The detector’s only validated edge is drawdown/shake-out control via trend eligibility.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks exhibits durable leadership with broad participation (breadth 0.86) and is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, which historically reduced drawdowns. While rank-IC is ~0, the trend-gate advantage suggests staying-power is better than most themes. Overweight conditional on trend persistence.
theses.dissent: Mixed Hurst tag warns the uptrend may not be strongly persistent; a shift in rate expectations could quickly reverse Bank momentum.

falsifier.text: Big Banks loses eligibility (trend-gate flips false) for five consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Despite eligibility, Base Metals carries extremely low durability (0.43) and zero breadth, signaling a fragile, non-participatory uptrend. The high momentum rank is not a return predictor; the weak internal structure justifies an underweight.
theses.dissent: A sudden commodity supply shock or strong global growth narrative could broaden participation rapidly, turning the fragile trend into a robust one.

falsifier.text: Base Metals' durability_bar rises above 0.50 and breadth exceeds 0.50 for five consecutive days.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is ineligible under the absolute-trend gate, which is the detector’s validated risk-control edge. History shows avoiding such themes materially reduces portfolio drawdowns. No return edge is claimed, but the risk reduction justifies avoidance.
theses.dissent: A geopolitical or monetary surprise could spark a flight to precious metals, propelling silver royalties into a sharp sustained uptrend despite current trend weakness.

falsifier.text: Silver & Royalties becomes eligible (trend-gate flips true) for five consecutive trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
